title: Launchpad KPI
tagline: Show KPIs of your apps on Fiori Launchpad tiles.
summary: A connector that lets an abap2UI5 app show a live number on a SAP Fiori Launchpad tile. A tile reads its number from an OData $count call, which an abap2UI5 app does not have; this repository brings the generic OData service Z2UI5_PROXY_KPI_SRV, which creates the class named in the filter and asks it for the count. Every app only has to implement the interface Z2UI5_IF_LP_KPI with its method count. A second FILTER condition in the OData call can pass a JSON string for different calculations.
features: Generic OData service Z2UI5_PROXY_KPI_SRV answers $count for the class in the filter
Implement one interface and one method (z2ui5_if_lp_kpi~count) in your app
Optional FILTER parameter as a JSON string for different calculations
requirements: S/4 Private Cloud or On-Premise, or R/3 NetWeaver AS ABAP 7.50 or higher (Standard ABAP)
ABAP for Cloud: not yet, a CDS/SADL based OData service is on the todo list

notes: Install with abapGit in this order: abap2UI5, then this repository from branch standard
Brings the interface Z2UI5_IF_LP_KPI, the sample Z2UI5_CL_LP_KPI_HELLO_WORLD and the OData service Z2UI5_PROXY_KPI_SRV
Maintain the tile at the launchpad with the same $count endpoint and your class name in the CLASS filter

usage:
INTERFACE z2ui5_if_lp_kpi
  PUBLIC.

  METHODS count
    IMPORTING
      filter        TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(result) TYPE i.

ENDINTERFACE.
